title: Mark Felt pushes to investigate the Mexico bank account

tellings.quote: Mark felt was getting he's the guy that was insisting upon going down the next morning to Mexico to investigate the bank account

plain: In 1972, a senior FBI official named Mark Felt is said to have insisted on flying to Mexico City the very next morning to look into a bank account there, one tied to money under investigation. A researcher named Dan Sheehan tells this on the show without naming a source, and he places Felt alongside his FBI superior, a man named Pat Gray. Sheehan tells it to suggest the bank account was a lead that someone inside the Bureau badly wanted followed.
